name: openapi_outline
description: Outline an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 or Swagger 2.0 document given inline as JSON or YAML: every endpoint with its method, operationId, summary, tags, parameters (path-level ones merged), request body and responses by status and media type, plus the component schemas, with $ref resolved inside the document. Returns a JSON outline and a Markdown summary, and warns about missing or duplicate operationIds and external refs. YAML is read by a built-in parser for the block subset OpenAPI files use; anchors and tags are refused clearly.

text.description: The OpenAPI or Swagger document, JSON or YAML

input.text:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Swagger Petstore
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /pets/{petId}:
    get:
      summary: Info for a specific pet
      operationId: showPetById
      parameters:
        - name: petId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Expected response to a valid request

catalog.source: OpenAPI Specification 3.0.3 and 3.1.0 and Swagger 2.0 (OpenAPI Initiative); YAML 1.2 core schema for the block subset read
